description: Installations solaires photovoltaïques au sol en Pays de la Loire - Saisie collaborative is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Solar photovoltaic energy is produced from solar radiation, thanks to photovoltaic modules that convert this radiation into electricity. Ground-based solar power plants are subject to a building permit instructed by the State authorities. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Solar photovoltaic installations on the ground in Pays de la Loire - Collaborative input" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
